title: Final thoughts on everything that has gone down the past couple days ...
transcript: Okay, final thoughts on this Patty article. Number one, it has been really nice to see the theater community as a whole rally behind Audra and Keisha. I've seen so many posts, either directly or indirectly, calling out Patty, and that has been really nice to see. And I just really hope it sticks, because this industry has a habit of calling people out and then in like a year just being like, it's okay, come on back. And so I'm really hoping that in like, a year, she's not going to be just welcomed back to Broadway with open arms, at least without her acknowledging or taking any meaningful steps to address some of her racial biases, because at this point, it seems very unlikely that we'll get any kind of statement from her. Also, on the subject of her actions in this article, I did just wanna say that I do believe that Patty's actions were racist. A lot of people rightfully pointed out that I didn't actually use that word in my initial video, and to be honest, I was just a complete oversight on my part. I think that you can argue over her intent, but what is not up for debate is that those actions were racist. They were micro aggressions, and they do deserve to be called out and treated as such. So, yeah, while obviously this whole situation has been incredibly disappointing, I think the one silver lining has been seeing the Broadway Community come together to call out this behavior, and I just really hope that we keep that energy moving forward. Final point, if you have not watched Audra McDonald's interview this morning on CBS Mornings, highly recommend. She is such a class act, so well spoken, and she speaks a little bit about the situation. So go watch it, because she deserves the world.
